answers.core: This greatly improves the `ItemList` experience right out of the box. It is a nice node since it comes with searching.
answers.workaround: To the best of my ability, no. The closest useful thing I could find that would help solve this issue is maybe doing crazy stuff with `my_item_list.get_item_at_position(my_pos)` inside a `_process` call, and it would be troublesome getting it to work with both mouse and gamepad. You could instantiate new `Button` under a vertical `ScrollContainer`, but then you lose out on the search functionality of `ItemList`.

title: Add something akin to an `item_focused(index : int)` signal for individual items in an `ItemList` node
